sources.note: Main homepage. Describes CureMD as integrated EHR, PM, and RCM platform for any size practice. Lists core products: EHR, PM, RCM, Specialty EHR, Mobile (Avalon), AI Scribe, AI Contact Center, Patient Portal. Claims 25+ years, #1 ambulatory EMR/PM rankings.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists current certification (SMART Cloud 10g, March 2023) and legacy certification (2014). Notes software dependencies: Medi-Span Drug Database, Surescripts, Leap Health, HAPI FHIR, Keycloak. Mentions additional fees for some certified features.

Practice management feature page. Details scheduling, eligibility verification, billing/claims, denial management, payment posting, KPI dashboards, document management, inventory management, multi-location support, secure messaging.

EHR feature page. Describes e-prescribing to 40,000+ pharmacies, clinical documentation, lab integration, clinical decision support (drug-drug, drug-allergy, drug-diagnosis checks), MIPS/MACRA compliance.

Specialty EHR page. Lists 32+ supported specialties with pre-built templates and specialty-specific workflows. Includes surgical, primary care, cardiology, GI, behavioral health, OB/GYN, oncology, ophthalmology, podiatry, and more.

EMR software page. Describes flexible charting, customizable templates, e-prescribing, lab integration with LabCorp/Quest, clinical decision support, analytics, patient reminders, RPM, telehealth, document management.

Behavioral health specialty page. Details treatment planning, progress tracking (GAD-7, PHQ-9), group therapy documentation, psychotherapy notes, mood tracking, EPCS, 42 CFR Part 2 compliance, RPM for mood/anxiety/sleep, multi-location support.

CCM feature page. Describes care plan creation, patient eligibility identification, time tracking, engagement monitoring, Medicare CCM billing (CPT 99490, 99439, 99487, 99489), audit-ready documentation, consent management.

Patient portal (LEAP) feature page. Describes health record access, lab results, medication tracking, secure messaging, appointment scheduling, digital check-in, online payments, wearable integration (Apple Watch, Fitbit), AI care gap alerts, CureDoc AI chatbot, family proxy access, telehealth access.
Company page. Founded 1997, 25+ years in healthcare IT, claims 30,000+ practices. KLAS award recognition. Based in New York.

January 2026 press release. Announces Rural Health Accelerator Package. Reveals: 300+ public health departments across 25 states, AI disease prediction models, 40% admin time reduction claim, 98%+ first-pass claims rate. Mentions LEAP portal, AI Clinical Scribe, integrated telehealth with HD video and RPM.

PeerSpot reviews. CureMD rated 9.0/10, ranked #10 on EHR leaderboard. Users praise user-friendly interface, integrated all-in-one solution, strong telehealth (scored 85 vs Epic 54). Cons: system bugs, billing module needs updates, learning curve, hidden fees.
Owler company profile. Reports ~$115M revenue, ~1,646 employees. Confirms mid-size healthcare IT company.

Software Finder listing. Confirms features including practice management, patient portal, medical billing, document management, lab interfacing, telemedicine. Notes 109,000 users across 44 states and 32 specialties.
